mapper.sql: id, request_id, user_id, payload_json, train_id, travel_date, seat_type, from_segment_index, to_segment_index, passenger_count, status, stock_reserved, stock_released, flow_state, owner_token, lease_until, next_retry_at, last_error, version, published_at, order_id, order_no, fail_reason, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_request (request_id, user_id, payload_json, train_id, travel_date, seat_type, from_segment_index, to_segment_index, passenger_count, status, stock_reserved, stock_released, flow_state, owner_token, lease_until, next_retry_at) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{userId}, #{payloadJson}, #{trainId}, #{travelDate}, #{seatType}, #{fromSegmentIndex}, #{toSegmentIndex}, #{passengerCount}, #{status}, #{stockReserved}, #{stockReleased}, #{flowState}, #{ownerToken}, #{leaseUntil}, #{nextRetryAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM order_request WHERE request_id = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE order_request SET status = 1, stock_reserved = 1, flow_state = 'RESERVED', owner_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, fail_reason = NULL, last_error = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND flow_state = 'CREATED' AND owner_token = #{ownerToken} AND status = 0 AND stock_reserved = 0

UPDATE order_request SET published_at = #{publishedAt} , flow_state = 'PUBLISHED' , next_retry_at = NULL , last_error = NULL , version = version + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = 1 AND flow_state = 'RESERVED' AND published_at IS NULL

UPDATE order_request SET status = 3, order_id = #{orderId}, order_no = #{orderNo}, flow_state = 'SUCCEEDED', owner_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL, published_at = COALESCE(published_at, NOW()), fail_reason = NULL, last_error = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status IN (1, 2) AND flow_state = #{fromState}
UPDATE order_request SET next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, last_error = LEFT(#{lastError}, 500), version = version + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = 1 AND flow_state = 'RESERVED'

UPDATE order_request SET status = 5, flow_state = 'RELEASING', fail_reason = LEFT(#{failReason}, 255), last_error = LEFT(#{failReason}, 500), next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, owner_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status IN (0, 1, 2) AND stock_released = 0
UPDATE order_request SET status = 4, stock_released = 1, flow_state = 'FAILED', next_retry_at = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND stock_released = 0 AND status IN (4, 5)

UPDATE order_request SET flow_state = 'MANUAL_REVIEW', fail_reason = LEFT(#{failReason}, 255), last_error = LEFT(#{failReason}, 500), next_retry_at = NULL, owner_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND flow_state NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'MANUAL_REVIEW')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM order_request WHERE id > #{lastId} AND flow_state <> 'SUCCEEDED' AND flow_state <> 'MANUAL_REVIEW' AND NOT (flow_state = 'FAILED' AND stock_released = 1) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
